title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

Northamptonshire On-Site £30,000 - £40,000 DOE

We're working with a growing, award-winning business in Northamptonshire that is looking to bring its digital marketing activity in-house for the first time.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a hands-on digital marketer who enjoys taking ownership, working closely with the wider business, and seeing the direct impact of their work. The company has a genuinely positive, supportive culture with a friendly team environment and strong staff retention.

The Role
- Manage and optimise SEO strategy across the company website
- Take ownership of Google Ads and paid search campaigns
- Monitor website performance and identify opportunities for growth
- Report on campaign performance and marketing ROI
- Work alongside external agencies and suppliers where required
- Help shape and develop the company's long-term digital strategy

About You
- Experience in SEO and PPC/Google Ads
- Confident working independently and taking ownership of projects
- Strong attention to detail
- Analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into actionable insights
- Comfortable reporting results to senior stakeholders
- Agency or in-house digital marketing experience considered

What's on Offer?
- £30,000 - £40,000 salary depending on experience
- Full-time, on-site position
- Friendly, collaborative and supportive team
- Positive working culture with a genuine focus on employee wellbeing
- Autonomy to make a real impact and influence marketing strategy
- Long-term progression opportunities within a growing business

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Role: Social and Digital Marketing Executive

Location: Kettering

Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday (office based)

Salary: £28,000 per annum

Want to put your creative skills and digital marketing experience to good use? An excellent opportunity has now arisen for a Social and Digital Marketing Executive to join a well-established client.

Duties of a Social and Digital Marketing Executive:
- Manage social media Plan content calendars, schedule posts and manage social media feeds across platforms including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok, engaging with new and existing audiences.
- Create engaging content Write social media copy, develop website content, design graphics, take photographs and shoot and edit short-form videos using a smartphone and editing tools.
- Manage digital campaigns Support and deliver paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and LinkedIn Ads, ensuring all promotional content aligns with brand guidelines.
- Improve online visibility Optimise website copy, meta descriptions and keywords to improve SEO and increase organic search traffic.
- Support email marketing Plan, create and schedule email marketing campaigns to engage both new and existing customers.
- Track performance Monitor campaign performance using Google Analytics and social media insights, measuring engagement, reach, conversions and ROI to improve future marketing activity.
- Support award submissions Research and write compelling entries for industry award submissions.
- Keep the website up to date Update website content with key information, photography, statistics and relevant business updates.
- Research the market Monitor competitor activity, industry trends and emerging digital marketing tools to identify new opportunities.

What we would like from you:
- 2 3 years' experience within social media and digital marketing.
- Proven experience managing social media platforms and creating engaging content.
- A great photographic eye and the ability to create and edit video content.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with excellent copywriting ability.
- Experience using social media scheduling tools and email marketing platforms.
- Knowledge of Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro.
- Experience with Google Analytics, Meta Insights and SEMrush.
- Salesforce experience would be advantageous.
- A creative, proactive and enthusiastic approach with strong commercial awareness.
- Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and turn insights into action.
- Ability to prioritise workloads, manage multiple tasks and work under pressure.
- Must hold a full UK driving licence.

If you are interested in this role, please apply below with your most recent CV.

BEDFORDPERM

title: E-Commerce Warehouse Team Leader
description:
Insight Employment are seeking a full-time E-Commerce Warehouse Team Leader for a client of ours based in Nether Heyford, Northampton.

Due to the location, you would need to have your own transport or live locally.

The Client: -

Is a fast-growing FMCG importer and e-commerce business, operating across leading online marketplaces and retail channels. They work with a broad portfolio of brands, combining strong commercial capability with a data-driven approach to buying, trading, and growth. Their focus is on building scalable, high-performing categories through strong supplier partnerships, efficient operations, and a results-led culture.

They are looking for a proactive and hands-on Warehouse Team Leader to oversee daily operations across their functions. The ideal candidate will lead by example, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and safety while maintaining high-performance standards across all warehouse activities.

This role is key to driving operational excellence within a busy, fast-paced eCommerce and multi-channel environment.

Key Responsibilities: -
- Lead, motivate, and develop warehouse operatives to achieve daily KPIs and operational targets.
- Supervise daily operations in your allocated department.
- Manage and prioritise workload to ensure timely and accurate fulfilment of orders.
- Maintain and promote a culture of Health & Safety, acting as a Health and Safety Champion on shift.
- Ensure all tasks are completed in line with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and contribute to their creation and ongoing review.
- Use Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and PDA/scanner devices to monitor inventory, track performance, and maintain accuracy.
- Support the management of Material Handling Equipment (MHE), ensuring correct usage, safety checks, and maintenance.
- Monitor and analyse key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify areas for improvement.
- Champion continuous improvement initiatives, including 5 S and Lean/Six Sigma principles.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with other departments (e.g. Customer Service, Buying, and eCommerce) to resolve issues and improve processes.
- Lead by example, this is a hands-on role requiring active participation in warehouse operations.

Skills & Experience Required: -

Essential:
- Minimum 2 years warehouse experience in a fast-paced environment.
- Minimum 1 year supervisory or team leader experience.
- Experience using Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
- Experience using PDA/scanners.
- Strong leadership and communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving ability.
- Ability to work effectively under pressure and to tight deadlines.
- Flexible and process-driven mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

Preferred:
- Counterbalance forklift licence.
- eCommerce and multi-channel warehouse experience.
- Experience using Linnworks or similar order management platforms.
- Knowledge or exposure to 5 S and/or Lean Six Sigma principles.

Experience: -
- Warehouse: 2 years (required)
- Supervising: 1 year (required)
- Warehouse management system: 1 year (required)

Benefits: -
- Employee discount
- Free parking

Shift/Hours: -

Shift patterns vary and can fall within anywhere from 6:00-22:00 Monday to Sunday, required to work 5 out of 7 days a week.

Rate: -

£14.00-£15.00 per hour depending on experience

This is temp to perm position to a suitable candidate.

If this sounds like your next career move don t delay send an up-to-date CV today.

Unfortunately, due to the high number of responses we receive it is not always possible to respond to every application. If you do not hear back from us within 7 days, please assume that you have been unsuccessful on this occasion. We will however retain your details on file and may contact you should another suitable vacancy arise.

title: Events & Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:
Events & Digital Marketing Coordinator

Location: Daventry

Working pattern: Permanent, full-time - 5 days office-based

The Opportunity

An established international business within the manufacturing and technology sector is looking for an organised and proactive Events & Digital Marketing Coordinator to support its UK and Ireland marketing activities.

The role will focus on showroom events, exhibitions, digital marketing and industry partnerships, helping to increase brand awareness and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate showroom events, product demonstrations and exhibitions, managing logistics, suppliers and budgets.
- Manage digital marketing, including website updates, email campaigns and social media.
- Liaise with internal teams, external agencies, suppliers and industry partners.
- Coordinate marketing materials, sponsorships and promotional activities.
- Maintain marketing calendars and campaign records.
- Support Sales with customer engagement and brand consistency.
- Monitor campaign performance and expenditure.

About You
- Previous experience in marketing, events or marketing coordination.
- Experience organising events and managing external suppliers.
- Knowledge of websites, email marketing and social media.
- Strong organisational, communication and project management skills.
- Good attention to detail and Microsoft Office skills.

B2 B, manufacturing or technical sector experience and a relevant marketing qualification would be advantageous.

A great opportunity for a hands-on marketing professional looking for a varied role combining events, digital marketing and commercial activity.

Please note: Fully office-based, 5 days per week in Daventry.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Morgan McKinley Northern Home Counties are proud to be representing a growing and purpose-driven business within Northamptonshire to recruit a Marketing Executive to join their expanding Sales & Marketing team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on and creative marketing professional who enjoys turning ideas into action. Working closely with the Head of Sales & Marketing, you will play a key role in delivering campaigns, managing digital activity, creating engaging content and supporting lead generation across the business.

This is not a Marketing Manager role. We are looking for a strong, proactive "doer" who is confident taking a vision or brief and bringing it to life through high-quality marketing activity across digital, social, web, email and offline channels.

Key Responsibilities:
- Plan, coordinate and deliver marketing campaigns across digital, social, email and offline channels
- Create engaging marketing content, including copy, imagery, video and promotional materials
- Manage and update website content, landing pages and digital campaigns
- Create and maintain marketing artwork and collateral for both digital and print
- Manage and support the company's social media activity
- Create and schedule email campaigns and marketing communications
- Support lead generation activity and monitor inbound leads
- Work closely with the Sales team to ensure marketing-generated leads are followed up and progressed
- Track campaign performance, lead sources and marketing effectiveness
- Maintain accurate marketing and lead data within CRM systems
- Attend exhibitions, events and demonstrations to support marketing and lead generation activity
- Conduct competitor and market research to support campaign development
- Provide ideas and recommendations to improve marketing performance and lead quality
- Work collaboratively with internal teams to ensure marketing activity supports wider business objectives

Candidate Requirements:
- Previous experience within a Marketing Executive or similar hands-on marketing role
- Experience delivering campaigns across digital, email, social and offline channels
- Strong content creation and copywriting skills
- Experience managing and updating websites and digital content
- Ability to create marketing artwork and promotional materials
- Experience with social media management and campaign delivery
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
- Commercially minded, with an understanding of lead generation and marketing performance
- Confident using CRM systems and marketing tools
- Creative, proactive and comfortable working independently
- Strong communication skills and attention to detail
- A relevant marketing qualification or degree would be advantageous, although practical experience will be equally valued
- Full UK driving licence and access to a car would be beneficial due to occasional events and travel requirements

What's on Offer:
- Salary between 35,000- 40,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid working following successful completion of probation and training
- Full office-based onboarding and training during the initial probation period
- Opportunity to take ownership of a varied and hands-on marketing role
- Career development and progression opportunities, including the potential to develop into a Senior Marketing Executive role
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Opportunity to work within a growing and purpose-driven business
- Additional employee benefits package

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
Hybrid Full Time Permanent
About the Employer
An established UK technology business providing IT infrastructure, data protection, disaster recovery and enterprise technology solutions to organisations across a range of sectors. Working closely with leading global technology vendors, the company combines specialist technical expertise with long-standing industry experience to help customers protect, manage and modernise business-critical IT environments.
The Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a hands-on Marketing Executive to join a growing B2 B technology marketing team. This practical, delivery-focused position will play an important role in turning marketing strategies into effective, measurable campaigns across digital channels.
Working closely with marketing, sales and SDR colleagues, you will build and manage campaigns in HubSpot, create landing pages and email sequences, develop marketing assets, support PPC and social media activity, and monitor campaign performance. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised marketer looking to develop their expertise in B2 B technology, campaign management and digital marketing.
Duties & Responsibilities
- Build and manage integrated marketing campaigns in HubSpot, including emails, landing pages, forms, lists, workflows and associated campaign assets.
- Maintain and organise the HubSpot portal to ensure campaigns, marketing assets, data and reporting remain accurate and consistent.
- Produce campaign reports and dashboards, monitoring marketing performance against agreed KPIs and objectives.
- Create professional landing pages, email campaigns and marketing resources in line with established brand and editorial guidelines.
- Plan, create and publish engaging social media content, particularly for LinkedIn, while supporting paid digital and PPC campaigns.
- Collaborate with marketing, SDR and sales teams to understand briefs and deliver both long-term campaigns and fast-turnaround marketing projects.
- Create and adapt visual marketing assets using Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud applications, while supporting website content development and management.
- Support channel and co-marketing campaigns with major technology vendors and strategic partners.

Education & Skills Required
- A degree in marketing or a related discipline, or an equivalent professional marketing qualification such as CIM, would be advantageous.
- Previous marketing experience, ideally within B2 B IT, technology or a channel environment such as a vendor, reseller, MSP or technology partner.
- Strong HubSpot skills covering campaign creation, management, automation, organisation, reporting and performance measurement.
- Experience creating professional landing pages, email campaigns, digital marketing content and associated campaign assets.
- Working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, combined with excellent written and spoken English and strong attention to detail.
- An organised, collaborative and dependable approach, with the ability to manage varied workloads, meet deadlines and communicate effectively with sales, SDR and marketing stakeholders. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
- Hybrid.
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:30pm.
- Banbury.
- Salary: 30 k to 35 k. (Depending on experience)

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Ready to put your marketing skills into pole position?

Silverstone Museum is looking for a creative, proactive and digitally savvy Marketing Executive to join our marketing team and help bring the stories of British motorsport to life.

Working closely with our Senior Marketing Executive, you'll play a key role in planning, delivering and tracking marketing campaigns that inspire people to visit, engage with our content and discover the heritage of Silverstone.

What will you be doing?
- Campaign delivery: Coordinate and deliver integrated marketing campaigns across social media, email, digital, print and events.
- Content creation: Write and edit engaging copy for social posts, newsletters, website pages and promotional materials.
- Digital marketing: Update website content, manage social media channels, support paid advertising and help improve SEO.
- Performance and insights: Monitor campaign results using analytics tools, report on performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement and return on investment.
- Market research: Keep up to date with competitor activity, visitor trends and customer data to help identify new opportunities.
- Team collaboration: Work with teams across the Museum, including Visitor Experience, Retail, Curation and the Sim Suite, as well as external agencies and media partners.
- CRM management: Maintain accurate customer databases and email lists, identifying opportunities to make better use of our customer data.

What are we looking for?

Someone with a passion for marketing, strong written communication skills and a keen eye for detail. You'll be organised, comfortable juggling multiple priorities and confident working with digital platforms and data. Most importantly, you'll be a team player who enjoys bringing ideas to life and making things happen.

Why Silverstone Museum?

Be part of a unique visitor attraction celebrating the people, stories and innovations behind British motorsport. You'll have the opportunity to contribute creatively, develop your marketing skills and help deliver memorable experiences for our visitors.

Ready to get started? Join us and help put Silverstone Museum on the map!

title: PPC / Paid Search Specialist
description:
PPC / Paid Search Specialist

Salary £37k-40k

Location Northampton Hybrid

Big on PPC & Paid Search? Ready to make a bigger impact?

There's something exciting happening at a growing independent digital agency in Northamptonshire - and they're looking for a talented PPC / Paid Search Specialist to be part of it.

This isn't a role where you'll just be tweaking bids and producing reports. It's an opportunity to take ownership, shape paid search strategies and make a genuine commercial impact across an exciting mix of clients.

You'll be joining an ambitious, collaborative agency that's growing, investing in its people and building something special.

Sound like your kind of move?

We're looking for someone who lives and breathes PPC, Paid Search and Google Ads, understands what drives conversions and knows how to turn paid media budgets into measurable results.

You'll ideally bring:
- Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, PPC, Paid Search and Performance Max.
- A sharp eye for ROAS, CPA, CPC and conversion optimisation.
- Confidence with GA4, Google Tag Manager and campaign tracking.
- Experience managing multiple campaigns and delivering results for clients.
- A curious, commercially minded approach - someone who wants to do more than just maintain campaigns.

Agency experience would be a real advantage, as would exposure to Microsoft Ads, Paid Social or Google Shopping campaigns.

Why is this worth a conversation?

Because the right move isn't always about a new job title.

It's about joining a business that's going places, having your ideas heard and getting the opportunity to do your best work.

What's on offer?
- Hybrid working in Northampton.
- A growing, independent Northamptonshire digital agency.
- Genuine ownership, creative freedom and the chance to influence strategy.
- A supportive, talented team and room to develop as the agency grows with career path to Head of PPC.

Ready for something more?

If you're a PPC Specialist, Paid Search Specialist, PPC Executive or Paid Media Specialist looking for a fresh challenge, this could be the move that takes your career up a gear

title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
